answer.answer: These are not independent confirming measurements in a sample-sharing sense: Reisser et al. 2013 and Eriksen et al. 2014 used different sampling platforms, net types, and time windows across broadly overlapping but non-identical Australia/NZ regions, so no shared-sample pairs exist to compute a Reisser/Eriksen ratio. No median ratio can be validly derived from these two independent surveys.
